section: Other global indices - Global Hunger Index, Environmental Performance Index, Ease of Doing Business, Global Innovation Index, World Happiness Report
subsections: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor
India's rank in the latest edition and trend

accepted.s: According to the Doing Business reports, India's rank in 2015, based on 2014 data, was
accepted.x: India was ranked 142nd in the Doing Business 2015 report, which was based on 2014 data.
accepted.tq: Use the date in parentheses to distinguish the reference year from the report year.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: India's rank in the Doing Business 2019 report, released in 2018, was
accepted.x: India ranked 77th among 190 economies in the Doing Business 2019 report released in 2018.
accepted.tq: Match the report year with the release year rather than confusing it with the data year.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: India's rank in the Doing Business 2020 report, based on 2019 data, was
accepted.x: India ranked 63rd out of 190 economies in the Doing Business 2020 report, based on 2019 data.
accepted.tq: Identify the latest figure in the stated five-year progression.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: India's position improved from 142 to 63 in the Doing Business rankings over a period of
accepted.x: India's rank improved from 142 in Doing Business 2015 to 63 in Doing Business 2020, a five-year progression.
accepted.tq: Calculate the period from the two report endpoints, not merely the numerical rank difference.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT a parameter of the World Bank's Ease of Doing Business assessment listed for India?
accepted.x: Literacy is not a listed Ease of Doing Business parameter. Getting electricity, registering property and resolving insolvency are included parameters.
accepted.tq: Find the socioeconomic indicator that does not belong to the business-regulation framework.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Ease of Doing Business assessment:
1. Starting a business is one of its parameters.
2. Getting credit is one of its parameters.
3. Per-capita income is one of its parameters.
4. Single Window System is counted in the assessment.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Starting a business, getting credit and the Single Window System are included. Per-capita income is not a parameter of the assessment.
accepted.tq: Separate business-process indicators from broad macroeconomic and social indicators.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s:
Which of the following combinations contains only parameters of the Ease of Doing Business assessment?
1. Construction permits
2. Protecting minority investors
3. Paying taxes
4. Literacy
accepted.x: Construction permits, protecting minority investors and paying taxes are parameters. Literacy is not included.
accepted.tq: Use elimination by identifying the broad social indicator among regulatory measures.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: In which of the following areas did India lag in the Ease of Doing Business assessment?
accepted.x: India was specifically noted as lagging in paying taxes.
accepted.tq: Test the identified weak sub-index directly against neighbouring parameters.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: India's rank in enforcing contracts in the Ease of Doing Business assessment was
accepted.x: India ranked 163rd out of 190 economies in enforcing contracts.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a sub-index rank from India's overall Ease of Doing Business rank.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: The Ease of Doing Business report served primarily as a ready reckoner for
accepted.x: The report functioned as a ready reckoner for foreign investors by comparing business regulations across economies.
accepted.tq: Link the index's practical purpose with its principal user group.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: The World Bank discontinued the Doing Business report mainly because of
o: the elimination of all business indicators
a fall in the number of participating economies
data irregularities and staff influence on rankings
the replacement of the World Bank by the IMF
accepted.x: The report was discontinued following concerns regarding data irregularities and staff influence on rankings.
accepted.tq: Identify the institutional reason for discontinuation rather than a change in rankings.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: The successor to the World Bank's Doing Business report is
accepted.x: B-READY is the successor to the discontinued Doing Business report.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the former index and its officially named successor.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: Which institution is the nodal agency for India's participation in B-READY?
accepted.x: The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) is the nodal agency for India's participation in B-READY.
accepted.tq: Apply the 'who would do this job?' method to identify the industry-promotion department.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: India is included in which edition of the B-READY report, with the report expected around September 2026?
accepted.x: India is included in the third B-READY report, expected around September 2026.
accepted.tq: Test the edition number directly, keeping it separate from the expected publication date.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: India's rank in the IMD World Competitiveness ranking changed from 43 in 2021 to which rank in 2025?
accepted.x: India's IMD World Competitiveness rank improved from 43rd in 2021 to 41st in 2025.
accepted.tq: Read the direction and endpoint of a ranking trend carefully.
accepted.sec: Ease of Doing Business - India's rank, sub-indices, lags, successor

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Global Hunger Index — Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe
World Happiness Report — World Economic Forum
accepted.x: The Global Hunger Index is published by Concern Worldwide of Ireland and Welthungerhilfe of Germany.
accepted.tq: Start from the distinctive two-organisation publisher pair.

accepted.s: The Environmental Performance Index is associated with which publishers?
accepted.x: The Environmental Performance Index is published by Yale and Columbia Universities.
accepted.tq: Match the environmental index with the academic institutions associated with it.

accepted.s: The Global Innovation Index is published by WIPO in association with
accepted.x: WIPO co-publishes the Global Innovation Index with Cornell University and INSEAD; this association dates from 2007.
accepted.tq: Use the co-publisher pair to distinguish the innovation index from other global indices.

accepted.s: The World Happiness Report is associated with the Wellbeing Research Centre of Oxford, together with
accepted.x: The World Happiness Report is associated with Oxford's Wellbeing Research Centre, Gallup and the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network.
accepted.tq: Identify the three-member institutional association rather than a single publisher.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: International IP Index — Global Innovation Policy Center
accepted.x: The Agriculture Orientation Index is published by FAO, not IFPRI. The Human Capital Index is associated with the World Bank and the International IP Index with the Global Innovation Policy Center of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce.
accepted.tq: Use the familiar organisation swap as the trap in a publisher question.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about WIPO is correct?
1. It was established in 1967.
2. It is a United Nations agency.
3. Its headquarters is in Geneva.
4. It has 193 members.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: WIPO was established in 1967, is a UN agency headquartered in Geneva and has 193 members.
accepted.tq: Combine institutional identity, location and numerical membership in one coded question.

accepted.s: The Global Talent Competitiveness Index is published by
accepted.x: INSEAD publishes the Global Talent Competitiveness Index.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the talent index publisher from the publisher of the competitiveness indices.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Corruption Perceptions Index — World Economic Forum
Travel and Tourism Development Index — Transparency International
accepted.x: The Logistics Performance Index is published by the World Bank. The Corruption Perceptions Index is published by Transparency International, while the Global Gender Gap and Travel and Tourism Development indices are associated with the World Economic Forum.
accepted.tq: Begin with the World Bank's distinctive logistics-related index and eliminate publisher swaps.

accepted.s: The Network Readiness Index is published by the
accepted.x: The Network Readiness Index is published by the Portulans Institute.
accepted.tq: Recall the specialised publisher rather than the publishers of the major economic indices.

accepted.s: India's rank in the Network Readiness Index improved from 79th in 2019 to which rank in 2024?
accepted.x: India's Network Readiness Index rank improved to 49th in 2024 from 79th in 2019.
accepted.tq: Track the stated improvement from the earlier rank to the latest rank.

accepted.s: India's rank in the World Happiness Report 2026 was
accepted.x: India ranked 116th out of 147 countries in the World Happiness Report 2026.
accepted.tq: Do not confuse India's rank with the ranks of neighbouring countries mentioned in the comparison.
accepted.sec: India's rank in the latest edition and trend

accepted.s: India's rank in the Global Hunger Index improved from 105 out of 127 in 2024 to which position in 2025?
accepted.x: India ranked 102nd out of 123 countries in the Global Hunger Index 2025, compared with 105th out of 127 in 2024.
accepted.tq: Compare both the rank and the number of countries in the two editions.
accepted.sec: India's rank in the latest edition and trend

accepted.s: India's score and classification in the Global Hunger Index 2025 were
accepted.x: India's Global Hunger Index 2025 score was 25.8, classified as serious.
accepted.tq: Separate the index score from rankings and from classifications used by other indices.
accepted.sec: India's rank in the latest edition and trend

accepted.s: India's rank in the Global Innovation Index improved from 81 in 2015 and 48 in 2020 to which position in 2025?
accepted.x: India ranked 38th out of 139 economies in the Global Innovation Index 2025, improving from 81st in 2015 and 48th in 2020.
accepted.tq: Read a multi-year rank trend from the earliest to the latest edition.
accepted.sec: India's rank in the latest edition and trend

accepted.s: India's rank and score in the Environmental Performance Index 2026 were
accepted.x: India ranked 176th out of 177 countries in the Environmental Performance Index 2026, with a score of 22.46.
accepted.tq: Keep the rank denominator and the index score as separate quantities.
accepted.sec: India's rank in the latest edition and trend

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with India's 2026 ranking?
accepted.x: India ranked 131st in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026, with parity of 64.5 percent.
accepted.tq: Link the percentage measure to the gender-parity index rather than to an environmental or innovation score.
accepted.sec: India's rank in the latest edition and trend

accepted.s: India's position in the Corruption Perceptions Index 2025 was
accepted.x: India ranked 91st in the Corruption Perceptions Index 2025 and received a score of 39; its rank improved by five places.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an index rank from its score and from the change in rank.
accepted.sec: India's rank in the latest edition and trend

accepted.s: India's rank in the Travel and Tourism Development Index was
accepted.x: India ranked 39th in the Travel and Tourism Development Index.
accepted.tq: Use the standalone rank without confusing it with the Network Readiness or corruption rankings.
accepted.sec: India's rank in the latest edition and trend

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes India's position in the World Happiness Report 2026 in relation to neighbouring countries?
o: India ranked above Nepal and Pakistan but below Bangladesh.
India ranked above all the neighbouring countries listed.
India ranked below all the neighbouring countries listed.
India ranked below Nepal and Pakistan but above Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Afghanistan.
accepted.x: India ranked 116th, below Nepal at 99th and Pakistan at 104th, but above Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Afghanistan.
accepted.tq: Arrange the comparative ranks before selecting the correct relational statement.
accepted.sec: India's rank in the latest edition and trend

accepted.s: Which country topped the World Happiness Report 2026?
accepted.x: Finland topped the World Happiness Report 2026 for the ninth consecutive year. Iceland and Denmark followed, while Afghanistan was last.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the first-ranked country from the immediately following countries and the last-ranked country.

accepted.s: Which of the following is the correct order of the top three countries in the Global Innovation Index 2025?
o: Sweden, Switzerland, United States of America
Switzerland, Sweden, United States of America
United States of America, Switzerland, Sweden
Switzerland, United States of America, Sweden
accepted.x: Switzerland ranked first, Sweden second and the United States of America third in the Global Innovation Index 2025.
accepted.tq: Preserve the order of the top three rather than identifying only the leading country.

accepted.s: Which country ranked tenth in the Global Innovation Index 2025?
accepted.x: China ranked tenth in the Global Innovation Index 2025.
accepted.tq: Test the specific position of a country separately from the top-three ranking.

accepted.s: Which country topped the Environmental Performance Index 2026?
accepted.x: Estonia topped the Environmental Performance Index 2026 with a score of 74.79; Luxembourg and the United Kingdom followed.
accepted.tq: Identify the top-ranked country while retaining the score as a confirming detail.

accepted.s: In the Environmental Performance Index 2026, India was ahead of only
accepted.x: India ranked 176th out of 177 countries and was ahead of only Laos.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the last country in one index from the last countries in other indices.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly gives the top three countries in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026?
accepted.x: Iceland, Finland and Norway were the top three countries in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026; Chad was last.
accepted.tq: Check the exact order of a closely grouped top-three list.

accepted.s: Which country was ranked last in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026?
accepted.x: Chad was ranked last in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate the last-ranked country in the gender index from the last-ranked countries in other indices.

accepted.s: Which country topped the Corruption Perceptions Index 2025 with a score of 89?
accepted.x: Denmark topped the Corruption Perceptions Index 2025 with a score of 89 and had held the top position for the eighth year.
accepted.tq: Match the leading country with its score and duration at the top.

accepted.s: Which country ranked first in Doing Business 2020?
accepted.x: New Zealand ranked first in Doing Business 2020.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the Doing Business leader from leaders of other global indices.

accepted.s:
The Global Hunger Index is based on which four indicators?
1. Undernourishment
2. Child stunting
3. Child wasting
4. Child mortality
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The four Global Hunger Index indicators are undernourishment, child stunting, child wasting and child mortality.
accepted.tq: Recall the complete four-part composition instead of relying on an incomplete older list.

accepted.s: The Global Hunger Index is measured on a scale of 0 to 100 in which a higher score indicates
o: greater hunger severity or worse outcomes
accepted.x: The Global Hunger Index uses a 0–100 scale, and a higher score indicates worse hunger conditions.
accepted.tq: Check the direction of the scale before interpreting the score.

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly describes the pillars of the Global Innovation Index?
1. Five input pillars
2. Two output pillars
3. Knowledge and technology outputs as an output pillar
4. Creative outputs as an input pillar
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Global Innovation Index has five input pillars and two output pillars. Knowledge and technology outputs is an output pillar, whereas creative outputs is also an output pillar, not an input pillar.
accepted.tq: Use the input-output classification to detect the reversed pillar statement.

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the six variables used in the World Happiness Report?
accepted.x: The six variables include GDP per capita, social support, healthy life expectancy, freedom, generosity and perceptions of corruption. Literacy rate is not listed among them.
accepted.tq: Find the familiar social indicator that is absent from the specified six-variable framework.

accepted.s:
Which of the following is included among the variables of the World Happiness Report?
1. GDP per capita
2. Freedom
3. Generosity
4. Perceptions of corruption
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: GDP per capita, freedom, generosity and perceptions of corruption are all among the six World Happiness Report variables.
accepted.tq: Use an all-correct combination when each item belongs to the stated index framework.

accepted.s: In the Environmental Performance Index 2026, the largest weight was assigned to
accepted.x: Ecosystem Vitality carried the largest weight at 45 percent, compared with 30 percent for Climate Change Mitigation and 25 percent for Environmental Health.
accepted.tq: Compare the three percentage weights rather than treating the index as equally weighted.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Environmental Performance Index 2026:
1. It covered 47 indicators.
2. It covered 177 countries.
3. Environmental Health carried a weight of 25 percent.
4. Climate Change Mitigation carried a weight of 45 percent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The EPI 2026 covered 47 indicators and 177 countries, and Environmental Health had a 25 percent weight. Climate Change Mitigation had 30 percent, not 45 percent; Ecosystem Vitality had 45 percent.
accepted.tq: Catch the swapped percentage between the two major environmental components.

accepted.s: The Corruption Perceptions Index uses a scale in which
o: 0 means very clean and 100 means highly corrupt
0 means moderate corruption and 100 means no data
0 means highly corrupt and 100 means very clean
both 0 and 100 indicate highly corrupt conditions
accepted.x: The Corruption Perceptions Index ranges from 0, meaning highly corrupt, to 100, meaning very clean.
accepted.tq: Check the direction of the corruption score before interpreting a country's performance.

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly describes the Corruption Perceptions Index?
1. It covers 182 countries.
2. It uses 13 data sources.
3. A higher score indicates a cleaner public sector.
4. A score of zero indicates a very clean public sector.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The CPI covers 182 countries, uses 13 data sources and interprets higher scores as cleaner conditions. A score of zero indicates highly corrupt conditions, making statement 4 false.
accepted.tq: Combine coverage, methodology and scale direction while rejecting the reversed endpoint.

accepted.s: The Agriculture Orientation Index is calculated as
o: agricultural employment divided by total employment
agriculture's share of government spending divided by its share of GDP
agricultural exports divided by agricultural imports
agriculture's share of GDP divided by its share of government spending
accepted.x: The Agriculture Orientation Index equals agriculture's share of government spending divided by agriculture's share of GDP.
accepted.tq: Preserve the numerator-denominator order in the ratio.

accepted.s: The Agriculture Orientation Index tracks which Sustainable Development Goal target indicator?
accepted.x: The Agriculture Orientation Index tracks SDG 2, specifically indicator 2.a.1.
accepted.tq: Match the agriculture-focused index with the agriculture-related SDG indicator.

accepted.s: The Government of India criticised the Global Hunger Index methodology primarily because
o: three of its four indicators cover only children and undernourishment relies on a small opinion-poll survey
all its indicators measure only agricultural exports
it uses only official census data from India
accepted.x: The Government of India argued that three of the four indicators concern only children and that the undernourishment measure rests on an opinion poll of about 3,000 respondents.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific methodological objections instead of accepting an absolute statement about all indicators.

accepted.s: Approximately how many respondents were involved in the opinion-poll survey cited in India's objection to the Global Hunger Index methodology?
accepted.x: The objection refers to an opinion-poll survey involving approximately 3,000 respondents for the undernourishment measure.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the order of magnitude in the survey-size figure.

accepted.s: The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change rejected the Environmental Performance Index methodology in
accepted.x: MoEFCC rejected the Environmental Performance Index methodology in 2022.
accepted.tq: Use the stated year to distinguish the methodological objection from later counter-evidence.

accepted.s: Which of the following was NOT an objection raised by India to the Environmental Performance Index methodology?
o: Preference for absolute emissions over per-capita emissions
Exclusive reliance on agricultural output indicators
accepted.x: India objected to the preference for absolute emissions, the neglect of the principle of Common but Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities, and the use of contested indicators. Agricultural output indicators were not identified as the objection.
accepted.tq: Find the unrelated sectoral claim among the stated methodological objections.

accepted.s: India's criticism that the Environmental Performance Index favours absolute emissions over per-capita emissions is described as
accepted.x: The criticism is described as a per-capita bias because the methodology is viewed as favouring absolute emissions over per-capita emissions.
accepted.tq: Match the criticism with its precise methodological label.

accepted.s: The principle which India stated was ignored by the Environmental Performance Index methodology is
accepted.x: India stated that the EPI methodology ignored CBDR-RC, the principle of Common but Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between environmental and trade-related international principles.

accepted.s:
Which of the following was cited as counter-evidence in response to concerns about India's environmental performance?
1. India ranked 23rd in CCPI 2026.
2. Fifty percent of India's installed power capacity was non-fossil in 2025.
3. India achieved this five years before the 2030 NDC target.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The counter-evidence includes India's 23rd position in CCPI 2026, 50 percent non-fossil installed power capacity in 2025 and achievement five years before the 2030 NDC target.
accepted.tq: Check whether all three quantitative and time-related counter-evidence statements belong together.
